title: Dan DiIorio - Luck be a Landlord - 10 Lessons Learned
speaker: Dan DiIorio
talk_title: Luck be a Landlord - 10 Lessons Learned
description: I'll be discussing 10 lessons I learned during the development of Luck be a Landlord, the slot machine roguelike deckbuilder. My goal is to share the knowledge I've gained with aspiring game designers and developers.
